subject: Your first 28 days in numbers
preview_text: The meetings you've captured, the hours you've saved, and what comes next.
body_paragraphs: It's been 28 days since you started using Smart Notes. Think back to that first meeting you recorded. Now look at what you've built: a searchable library of every key decision, every action item, every 'I'll send that over later' you never had to chase. That's momentum.

Here's the thing most people miss after a month: the real win isn't the summaries you already have. It's the pattern you're creating. Each time you hit record, you're training yourself to stop relying on memory and start trusting a system. That shift is what saves you hours every week, not just one meeting at a time.

You've already experienced the core feature: one-tap recording that turns chaos into clarity. But there's a layer you haven't tapped yet: language-aware transcription. If you record in a different language than your profile, Smart Notes adjusts automatically. Try it on a call where English isn't the main language and see how the action items still land perfectly.

Open the app now and replay one summary from your first week. Notice how much smoother your follow-ups feel now. That's the system working. P.S. Users who review their first-month history are 3x more likely to stick for the next 28 days. Don't break the streak.
